Yaśodā
------------------------------------------
Yaśodā was the queen of नन्द, the chief of the cowherds of गोकुल. When she gave birth to a girl, the child was exchanged with कृष्ण, the eighth son of देवकी. Consequently कृष्ण spent his childhood and early boyhood days at नन्द’s होउसे thereby giving यशोदा the chance of his company and of enjoying his childish pranks.
See NANDA.
